臺灣總督府統計書 1942

Taiwan Sōtokufu tōkeisho (Statistical Yearbook of the Government-General of Taiwan), 第四十六 (No. 46), 昭和十七年 (Shōwa 17), published 1944
臺灣總督府, 臺北, 1944 (昭和十九年三月)

All 371 numbered tables are transcribed, with one unnumbered block beside table 29 and the table of weights and measures; the contents pages are not. The NDL scan is low-resolution and often blurred, so this volume has far more unreadable cells than the earlier ones: about 2,460 of some 109,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?] (in 250 tables), and many column headings and row labels in small type contain [?] for characters that could not be made out. The book prints figures in groups of four digits (8 1897 = 81,897); they are written here with standard thousands commas. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections by different readers are joined. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted (many differ by a yen or two of rounding; on this scan some differences may be misreadings that could not be resolved). Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Small figures printed under a main figure with a mark such as × or △ (e.g. 兼務, 工賃) are written after it, as in "209 ×24"; where they were too small to read they are given as ×[?] or, in a few tables, left out, as each table's notes say. A literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?. No independent second reading was made for this volume.
